docs.text: New documentary to catch on Prime Video! The Fish Thief: A Great Lakes Mystery Paraphrased quote: “Government investment in science benefits the economy.” Tells the story of how we got sea lamprey under control in the Great Lakes to restore collapsed fisheries. 🧪

I really suggest if you haven't seen it yet you watch The Fish Thief A Great Lakes Mystery so you fully understand what cuts to the Sea Lamprey Control Program could do to the Great Lakes economy. It's free on Prime Video and only 99c on Apple.

The Fish Thief is a good documentary and scary as fuck about how devastating the Lampreys are to the Great Lakes, stopping that program will be disastrous, but at least eggs are cheaper, you stupid fucks!

The invasive sea lamprey brought Great Lakes fishing to its knees in the fifties and sixties, until local communities and scientists battled back. The new film ‘The Fish Thief’ explores the fight. #getoutside #journalism
If you’re a Midwesterner and/or a Great Lakes-er, I strongly recommend the docu that just dropped “The Fish Thief.”

If you do watch The Fish Thief A Great Lakes Mystery take special note of what happened to that area's economy until the Sea Lamprey Control program began working and being implemented. And understand what losing that program will truly mean.
